summary: I tested the wizard K×F change (B1–B3) and offline mode (A1–A5) on a 375x667 viewport. Backend: the new test_injection_kf.py passes 9/9, and together with the factor K/F tests that is 43/43. Wizard: with K 0.135 and F 1.093 it gives Vtotal 8.93 L, V1 714 mL, water 8214 mL and 1.51 bottles, both online and offline, and the sheet-missing flow works, including the refresh when you come back from the sheet. Offline: cached list and case detail render, the 'Sin conexión · N pendientes' pill shows, and you can create a case with K/F/signature, add a note and a logbook entry, and run and save calculations, which use local formulas. After reconnecting the queue syncs, the case gets a PRV number and the data is on the server. The conflict modal works for both keep-mine and use-server. Bugs found: (1) a queued note, logbook entry or calculation skips conflict detection for a later sheet edit on the same case, so server edits are silently overwritten; (2) the sync pill covers the main buttons on calculator and wizard screens; (3) delete actions have no error handling when offline, so no toast appears.

minor.issue: 15 old tests fail in test_pdf_publish.py and test_preservia_api.py. They date from when the app had login (test_me_endpoint, test_user_isolation, the no-token 401 check, the old subcategory rules, KeyError 'ficha_id'). These are not regressions from this change; the tests are out of date and should be updated or removed. Overall: 114 passed, 15 failed.

ui_bugs.issue: The pill is placed at bottom = insets.bottom + 84 with zIndex 50 on every screen, including full-screen stack screens that have no tab bar. While offline or with pending changes it covers the middle of calc-compute-button (calculator/[type]) and of wiz-compute-lbm and wiz-compute-volume (wizard), even when scrolled to the bottom. A tap in the middle of the button lands on the pill, so 'Calcular' looks like it does nothing; I could only press it by tapping near the button's left edge. Reference: src/components/SyncCenter.tsx:71

deleteCase, deleteNote, deleteCalc, deleteLogEntry and deleteAttachment have no try/catch. When offline, tapping case-delete gives no toast and the promise rejection is not handled, which does not meet A5. deleteCase also deletes the whole case on a single tap with no confirmation. Reference: app/case/[id].tsx:174-333
The viewer shows the generic 'No se pudo cargar el documento'. It does not crash, but it gives no message that the report needs internet.

integration_issues.issue: In sync.ts:75, any op that succeeds runs confirmed.add(cid), including note, logbook and calculation POSTs. If a note, logbook entry or calculation for a case comes before that case's sheet edit in the queue, the conflict check for the PUT /sheet is skipped and the server's changes are silently overwritten. Reproduced: offline, add a note and then edit the sheet; meanwhile PUT the sheet via curl; go online → no sync-conflict modal, and the local sheet replaced the server version.

issues: wiz-kf-card has about 30px of empty space at the top inside the card
wiz-compute-volume sits directly under the card with no gap (use 16px)
the 'masa magra' label is lowercase while 'Factor K' and 'Factor F' are capitalised
The pill's minHeight is 36, below the 44px touch target; hitSlop 8 partly compensates

action_items: HIGH: Fix conflict detection in src/offline/sync.ts. Run the server updated_at check before sending the first queued op of a case that has any PUT/PATCH op with base_updated_at, using the earliest base. Only mark the case as confirmed after that check, not after any successful POST of a note, logbook entry or calculation.

HIGH: Move the sync pill so it does not cover main buttons. Options: show it only on tab screens; place it at the top on stack screens; or add matching bottom padding or footer awareness on the calculator and wizard screens.
MEDIUM: Wrap the delete handlers in app/case/[id].tsx in try/catch and show toast.show(e.detail, 'error') when offline. Add a confirmation before deleting a case.
LOW: Show an offline-specific message or toast in the viewer when the report or attachments cannot load offline.
LOW: Update or remove the outdated auth-era tests in test_pdf_publish.py and test_preservia_api.py.
critical_code_review_comments: sync.ts: when a server rejects a change, the op is dropped with only a toast (lastError). If a POST /cases is rejected, its child ops stay queued with local ids and will fail as well.
A case created offline cannot be deleted or cancelled while still pending: DELETE on a local id throws.
use-case-sheet-info.ts swallows errors silently (.catch(() => {})). If the case cannot be read, the wizard shows 'missing sheet' instead of an error.
app/case/[id].tsx is 1156 lines and server.py is 1751 lines; both are over 700 lines and should be split.

success_rate.backend: 100% for the new features (43/43); 114/129 for the full suite, with all failures in outdated auth-era tests
success_rate.frontend: about 85%: B2, B3, A1, A2, A3 and A4 (both choices) pass; A5 partly (delete gives no toast); conflict bug when a note or calculation is queued before a sheet edit

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ cases were created and all of them were deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth: tap welcome-skip first. Offline: use page.context.set_offline(True) only after the app has loaded, and move with in-app taps (page.goto does not work offline). localStorage holds off_queue and off_idmap (local id → real id). Case detail tabs are tab-calc, tab-notes, tab-logbook, tab-docs and tab-report. To edit an existing case's sheet: case-edit → kcond-*/cond-* → create-case-button. New case: new-case-fab. While the pill is visible, tap calculator/wizard main buttons with page.mouse.click near the left edge, or the pill catches the tap. Signature: mouse move with steps=4 inside signature-pad.
rca_of_issue: Conflict bug: sync.ts adds cid to 'confirmed' after any successful op (line 75), and the conflict check only runs when !confirmed.has(cid). The note POST runs first and updates the server's updated_at; then the sheet PUT skips the check and overwrites. Pill overlap: the pill is absolutely positioned for the tab-bar layout but is mounted globally above stack screens that have bottom footers.
